title: statusLine stdin contract: ccx never emits transcript_path, and session_id is null on every startup and post-/clear invocation
repro: configure a statusLine command that dumps stdin to a file
launch ccx, run a turn, run /clear
diff the emitted key sets against claude's for the same settings
claude: session_id and transcript_path are present on EVERY invocation including the very first at startup and the one fired by /clear (claude mints a fresh id there: 095baa0c… -> a02ce69d…). transcript_path points at the live .jsonl. Evidence: statusline-payloads-cc.jsonl, statusline-key-diff.txt
ccx: transcript_path is absent from all 7 recorded invocations. session_id is absent on invocations #1, #2 (startup) and #5 (fired by /clear), appearing only once a turn has begun. So a statusLine script that keys a cache on session_id, or reads the transcript to render its own summary, gets nothing at startup and nothing after /clear — the two moments the line is most visible. Evidence: statusline-payloads-ccx.jsonl, statusline-key-diff.txt, sl-ccx-postclear.txt (renders 'sid=None'), sl-cc-postclear.txt (renders 'sid=a02ce69d')
suspects: the statusLine payload builder in harness/src/tui/ (statusLine hook wiring added by Wave C)

Raising as a question rather than a defect because the owner's spec asked for exactly this. Frames: ccx-slfail.txt, ccx-slfail2.txt, ccx-slfail2.sgr

Launched at 120x40 the same binary reports alt=0 mouse=000, and RESIZING that session down to 80x24 does not flip it — so it is a launch-time decision keyed on the initial viewport height, not a live geometry response, and it does not reverse when the pane is grown back to 120x40. Flagging as version drift for the controller rather than adjudicating whether ccx should follow.

title: ccx renders the statusLine with SGR 2 (dim) where claude uses palette grey 38;5;246
repro: capture-pane -e -p with a statusLine configured and compare the escape prefix on that row
claude: '^[[39m  ^[[38;5;246mS2-STATUS …^[[39m' — an explicit palette index, so the row is the same grey on every terminal and is unaffected by a terminal that renders dim as a font-weight change.
ccx: '^[[39m  ^[[2mS2-STATUS …^[[0m' — SGR 2. On terminals that implement dim as faint-white it looks close to claude's; on terminals that ignore SGR 2 (several do) the statusLine renders at full default foreground and stops reading as chrome. Same 2-space indent and same slot, so this is purely the colour mechanism. Note the footer has the same split: the mode chip uses truecolor 38;2;153;153;153 while its tail uses SGR 2. Frames: sl-ccx-postturn.sgr, sl-cc-postturn.sgr
